summary: Health-tech innovation is advancing on multiple fronts today. Novartis is testing whether a newly acquired anti-inflammatory drug can translate inflammation reduction into meaningful improvements in cardiac outcomes, a critical question as the pharmaceutical industry seeks therapies that address root causes of heart disease rather than just symptoms. In Asia-Pacific healthcare infrastructure, Malaysia's Ministry of Health has partnered with HIMSS to launch a digital maturity initiative in Perlis state, signaling regional investment in healthcare technology modernization. Meanwhile, business model innovation is emerging around AI deployment, with flat-fee pricing structures enabling sustainable scaling of artificial intelligence tools in healthcare settings—addressing a key challenge in making advanced technologies economically viable for broader adoption.

items.title: STAT+: A Novartis drug cut inflammation. Can it improve heart outcomes?
Malaysia MOH, HIMSS announce digital maturity initiative in Perlis
